reviewedProperties.assessment: Actual factories and family-installed programs are inspected. Duplicate IDs, removals and other additions fail. Exactly one Facet workflow registration is required.
The declaration, candidate archive, native manifests, historical tools, cases and trace bytes are bound. Measured outputs and readiness may not precede contract finalization.
The qualifier compares a cold seven-field owner and chronological operations. Proposals may only reset the declared local fields at a new epoch. Every offer and record is rejected.

Complete capture graphs are rebuilt from exact Kernel delta chains. Added installations, source owner states and reachable fragments are attributed. Count and revision differences must equal actual attributed nodes and deltas; no constant delta is assumed.

Common node identities and metadata, delta causes and delta order are compared, with the runtime source digest difference qualified. Common private values are retained but are not claimed equal. Matching measured structural forms does not prove uncaptured private leaves.

Untimed forms require STCK 3/10 and SMLP 3/15 actions with exact current trace commands and public packets. Raw timed trials must match their own version form. Changed actions, cycles, requests or acquisitions cannot be hidden as allowed structure.

A1/B1/B2/A2 covers 32 measured sessions and 400 actions. Eight warmups and 24 actions are excluded in advance; no measured session or outlier is excluded. Eight complete session elapsed values per game and version are pooled before the median. Each game must satisfy strict after < 1.1 * before independently. No cross-game compensation or average of cohort ratios is used.
Phase and p95 results remain visible. Global acceptance depends on both global cases, not phaseStatus. The independent Python review reproduces the decimal global criterion and diagnostic metrics.

The original strict aggregator must actually run. Its nonzero exit, exact command, input hashes and complete expected metadata refusal are verified. A qualified consolidation does not relabel that failure.

Outputs are exclusive and inputs are rechecked. All four logs are retained; gzip transport is compared byte for byte after decompression. The renderer binds results to actual frozen identities and preserves unresolved phases.
